title: Alert policies, notification channels and on-call fatigue

videos.script: An alert is a promise. It says someone has to do something, now. {{promise}} A policy watches a metric every minute. Two choices make or break it. How long the value has to stay bad. And what silence means. {{policy}} For a counter of failures, silence means everything is fine. Treat it any other way and the phone rings on quiet nights. {{silence}} Then the person on the other end. A month of alerts that fix themselves teaches anyone to ignore alerts. Including the one that mattered. {{fatigue}} You will count a month of notifications, find the policy that sends most of them, and delete it. Nothing real goes unnoticed. {{delete}}
